label: DEMO DATA: synthetic scenarios written by the SafeCircle team. Not real messages, victims or attacks.
notes: Written after the Scam DNA rules, by the same team, without re-tuning the rules afterwards. Results are therefore an optimistic sanity check, not a measure of real-world accuracy. Domains use the reserved .example TLD; UPI handles start with 'demo'.
positive_definition: A scenario counts as flagged when the case reaches medium or high risk, or is marked for review.

scenarios.label: benign
scenarios.description: Genuine-style KYC reminder pointing to the official app (false-positive test)

events.content: Reminder from your bank: please complete your periodic KYC update in the official mobile app or at your home branch. We never ask for OTP or PIN by call or SMS.
Your electricity bill of Rs 1,180 for September is generated. Due date 20-Oct. Pay through the official app or website.
Hey, dinner came to 1800 so your share is 450. Send it on GPay whenever you get a chance, no rush!
